**Path Switch Acknowledge carries the transfer**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NGAP / UE Mobility Management Procedures / Path Switch Request |
| Tags | none |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 15s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Owns | Xn path switch |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration, PDU session establishment |

## Clauses

- TS 38.413 8.4.4.2 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-17: sentences are added around the cited one in Rel-17 and Rel-18 (IAB-MT, MT communication handling, RedCap); the cited sentence is the same Rel-15 through Rel-19)
- TS 38.413 8.4.4.3 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 reads "fails to switch the downlink GTP tunnel endpoint towards a new GTP tunnel endpoint" and ends "with an appropriate cause value"; by V15.13.0 it reads "fails to switch the downlink termination point of the NG-U transport bearer towards a new termination point", unchanged through V19.4.0)
- TS 38.413 9.3.4.9 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: UL NG-U UP TNL Information is M in V15.0.0 and O from V15.1.0; its semantics text dates from V15.3.0; Rel-16: the UL NG-U UP TNL Information row is unchanged Rel-16 through Rel-19; other optional IEs are added (redundant TNL, QoS Flow Parameters List))
- TS 38.413 9.2.3.9 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 has a PDU Session Resource to be Switched in Uplink List (0..1); the PDU Session Resource Switched List with a mandatory Path Switch Request Acknowledge Transfer per item dates from V15.1.0)
- TS 38.413 9.1.1 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NGAP-PATH-SWITCH-ACK-TRANSFER.md).
